note: S1 (FEATURE-GAP 2.10): surrender vote. Sim rules (src/sim/surrender.ts): minStartS = earliest vote start (15:00), voteS = vote length, unanimousUntilS = before this game time ALL voters must agree (LoL 15-20 min), afterwards ceil(voters * needShare) (4 of 5), cooldownS = pause after a failed vote. bot = voting rule of the bots (src/ai/bot/social.ts surrenderScore): score = wGold * gold deficit + wKill * kill deficit + wTower * tower deficit + tiltBonus * tilt stacks, each deficit scaled to 0..1 by its scale (gold = item value difference of the two teams, public like the scoreboard); a bot votes yes when score >= threshold of its rank band. delayS = [min, max] seconds until the bot votes.
